title: Purported AI Name-Reading System Reportedly Skipped and Misannounced Graduates at Arizona's Glendale Community College Commencement

behaviors.text: Glendale Community College in Arizona reportedly used an AI-powered name-reading system during its May 2026 commencement ceremony.

The system allegedly mishandled the graduate roll call, leaving some students without the expected public announcement of their names as they crossed the stage and prompting frustration from attendees.
